original_question: Let C_f: W^p - W = f(X) in k[X] be a p-cyclic cover of the affine line over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic p > 0. Given an extension of Z/pZ by an elementary abelian p-group (Z/pZ)^n that can occur as a p-Sylow subgroup of Aut(C_f), is it possible to choose f(X) in F_p[X] so that C_f realizes that extension, with the kernel Z/pZ equal to the Artin-Schreier covering group defined by C_f?
target_in_paper: Question 6.1 in §6.1.1 ("Rationality conditions") of §6.1, "p-groups as automorphism groups of curves in characteristic p," in the Lehr–Matignon section "Automorphisms of curves and stable reduction."
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the exact open problem the paper asks: it uses the Artin-Schreier model C_f : W^p - W = f(X), works in characteristic p > 0 over an algebraically closed field, identifies the relevant group as an extension of Z/pZ by an elementary abelian p-group, asks for realization as a p-Sylow subgroup of Aut(C_f), and includes the paper's crucial parenthetical requirement that the kernel Z/pZ be the Artin-Schreier covering group attached to C_f.
missing_details: The paper states the group extension explicitly as an extension of Z/pZ by (Z/pZ)^n with n >= 0; your draft leaves the exact-sequence form implicit.
The ambient automorphism group is the automorphism group of the curve C_f over the algebraically closed base field k; that base-field dependence is implicit in your wording.

The paper makes explicit that the problem is a rationality/descent question: such extensions are already known to occur for some f(X) in k[X], and the question is whether one can choose f(X) with coefficients in the prime field F_p instead.
The kernel Z/pZ is not just any distinguished subgroup; it is specifically the deck-transformation group of the Artin-Schreier cover C_f -> A^1_k.
No general degree restriction is part of the question itself; the only degree condition mentioned nearby is an example for D8, so degree bounds should not be built into the main reformulation.
refined_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 0, and let C_f be the Artin-Schreier curve C_f : W^p - W = f(X) with f(X) in k[X]. It is known that a p-Sylow subgroup G of Aut(C_f) is an extension 1 -> Z/pZ -> G -> (Z/pZ)^n -> 1 for some n >= 0, where the kernel Z/pZ is the Artin-Schreier covering group of C_f, and conversely every such extension occurs for some C_f. Given such an extension G, can one choose f(X) in F_p[X] so that C_f realizes G as a p-Sylow subgroup of Aut(C_f), with the kernel Z/pZ equal to the Artin-Schreier covering group of C_f?
justification: The draft is essentially a near-verbatim restatement of the paper's Question 6.1, so the correct target is that question rather than any broader neighboring problem. The only refinements needed are to make the exact sequence, the quantifier n >= 0, the base-field setting, and the descent-to-F_p aspect fully explicit. I did not fold the subsequent D8 degree example into the main question, because the paper presents it only as an illustration and not as part of the formal problem statement.
